limitations: Search write failures are logged but not durably retried; run search:reindex after recovery.
Pause writes during rebuild; search may temporarily return partial projection until rebuild completes.
Kubernetes OpenSearch emptyDir is lost on pod replacement; reindex after replacement.
Cardinality count is approximate at large scale; result-window overflow falls back to PostgreSQL.
Cache revision rows grow with deleted IDs; no pruning job.
Cache hits still read lightweight PostgreSQL metadata and current display fields.
Arbitrary direct bulk SQL bypasses callbacks; supplied seed builder handles its own invalidation/rebuild.
Local OpenSearch security is disabled; not production-grade.
